eyebrow.en: Transform HTML with explicit tag, attribute and font rules, producing an editable article fragment with diagnostics.

caption.zh: HTML 树变换 · 本地诊断

body.zh: 先处理标签和属性，再整理字体。
body.en: Process tags and attributes before normalizing fonts.

body.zh: 删除、展开和字体替换均可查看。
body.en: Inspect removals, unwrapping and font replacements.

body.zh: GzhCtx 让调用方选择自己的允许集合。
body.en: GzhCtx lets callers select their allowed sets.

title.zh: 把格式整理拆成可检查步骤

body.zh: 生成的 HTML 往往含脚本、嵌入内容和自定义字体，复制到文章编辑器后可能变化。GzhSeam 先按仓库规则做本地变换，报告删除和字体映射，让作者查看产物再交给目标平台。
body.en: Generated HTML can contain scripts, embeds and custom fonts that change when pasted into an article editor. GzhSeam applies repository-defined transforms locally and reports removals and font mapping so authors can inspect the result before using a target platform.

body.zh: 真实 CLI 清洗完整 HTML fixture，随后读回产物并检查二次处理与自定义白名单。没有上传图片、登录公众号或验证编辑器粘贴效果。
body.en: The real CLI transforms a complete HTML fixture, followed by output readback, a second pass and a custom whitelist. No images are uploaded, no WeChat login occurs, and editor paste behavior is not tested.

alt.zh: 真实 CLI 清洗完整 HTML fixture，随后读回产物并检查二次处理与自定义白名单。没有上传图片、登录公众号或验证编辑器粘贴效果。
alt.en: The real CLI transforms a complete HTML fixture, followed by output readback, a second pass and a custom whitelist. No images are uploaded, no WeChat login occurs, and editor paste behavior is not tested.

body.zh: washer.py 依次调用 whitelist.filter_html 与 fonts.normalize_fonts。前者删除指定标签、展开非白名单容器并剥离属性，后者整理 inline font-family。GzhCtx 的 per-call 覆盖在 v0.5.0 已透传。CDN 阶段仍为 stub。
body.en: washer.py calls whitelist.filter_html and then fonts.normalize_fonts. The first drops selected tags, unwraps unsupported containers and strips attributes; the second normalizes inline font-family. v0.5.0 forwards per-call GzhCtx overrides. The CDN stage remains a stub.

alt.zh: washer.py 依次调用 whitelist.filter_html 与 fonts.normalize_fonts。前者删除指定标签、展开非白名单容器并剥离属性，后者整理 inline font-family。GzhCtx 的 per-call 覆盖在 v0.5.0 已透传。CDN 阶段仍为 stub。
alt.en: washer.py calls whitelist.filter_html and then fonts.normalize_fonts. The first drops selected tags, unwraps unsupported containers and strips attributes; the second normalizes inline font-family. v0.5.0 forwards per-call GzhCtx overrides. The CDN stage remains a stub.

body.zh: 工具整理 HTML，不生成文章、不替平台审核，也不自动发布。CLI 的成功信息表示本地转换写入完成，不能直接当作公众号兼容性验收。
body.en: The tool prepares HTML; it does not generate articles, perform platform review or publish automatically. A successful CLI message means the local transform was written, not that WeChat compatibility was accepted.

alt.zh: 工具整理 HTML，不生成文章、不替平台审核，也不自动发布。CLI 的成功信息表示本地转换写入完成，不能直接当作公众号兼容性验收。
alt.en: The tool prepares HTML; it does not generate articles, perform platform review or publish automatically. A successful CLI message means the local transform was written, not that WeChat compatibility was accepted.

body.zh: 当前 --cdn 返回未实现错误；默认 wash 只在本地处理。
body.en: --cdn currently returns an unimplemented error; default wash stays local.

note.zh: 真实 CLI 清洗完整 HTML fixture，随后读回产物并检查二次处理与自定义白名单。没有上传图片、登录公众号或验证编辑器粘贴效果。
note.en: The real CLI transforms a complete HTML fixture, followed by output readback, a second pass and a custom whitelist. No images are uploaded, no WeChat login occurs, and editor paste behavior is not tested.

body.zh: 查看标签、属性和字体的实际诊断。
body.en: Inspect the actual tag, attribute and font diagnostics.

steps.output:
→ 解析 HTML (1 个 deck, 1 张图)
→ 过滤标签白名单 (移除 <script>, <canvas>, on* 事件)
→ 字体规整 (font-family → 公众号允许集)
✓ examples/presentation-output.html 已生成（纯本地洗，可直接贴入公众号编辑器就地改一个字）
  ! unwrapped <article> (not in whitelist)
  ! dropped <script> (platform-incompatible)
  ! unwrapped <custom-note> (not in whitelist)
  · font-family: "'Fira Code', monospace" -> 'monospace'

body.zh: 检查二次处理相等，并演示只允许 p 标签。
body.en: Check second-pass equality and demonstrate allowing only p tags.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。本地 wash 不需要公众号凭据，也不会下载示例中的远程图片。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Local wash needs no WeChat credentials and does not download the fixture’s remote image.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/gzhseam.git
cd gzhseam
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python -m gzhseam.cli wash examples/presentation-input.html -o examples/presentation-output.html --verbose
python examples/presentation_inspect.py

limitations.zh: 规则来自仓库，未实时验证目标平台当前粘贴行为。
limitations.en: Rules come from the repository and were not checked against current platform paste behavior.

limitations.zh: CDN、认证与自动发布不在已实现路径中。
limitations.en: CDN upload, authentication and automatic publication are not implemented paths.

limitations.zh: HTML 规则转换不是通用安全证明或完整浏览器沙箱。
limitations.en: HTML rule transformation is not a general security proof or browser sandbox.
